SvFrontendName.description: The RTL front end of a lift: `auto` (the environment's default), `verilog` (yosys `read_verilog`), `slang` (the yosys-slang plugin) or `sv2v` (sv2v, then `read_verilog`). The CLI's `--frontend` takes the same four values.

SvLiftRequest.description: The SV design and how to lift it, shared by every `sv` route: the API peer of the CLI's lift flags (`SV_FILE` / `--source`, `--top`, `--frontend`, `--param`, `--lift-override`, `--cutpoint`, `--merge-clock-domains`). Unknown keys are refused.

cutpoints.description: Control-slice cut points: each named net becomes a free input (an over-approximation).

lift_overrides.description: Lift-only replacements of a source by file name (an assertion-macro shim, a synthesis variant). `sv verify-auto` still extracts its SVA from the original sources.

merge_clock_domains.description: Lift a multi-clock design onto the model's one implicit clock instead of refusing it. An UNDER-approximation: the domains only ever tick together, so a HOLDS does not transfer.

source_name.description: The primary source's file name, which `lift_overrides` match (default `<top>.sv`, or `top.sv` without a `top`).

description: Request for `POST /api/v1/sv/verify-recoverability` — the SV lift fields plus the recoverability target atom.

discover_assumptions.description: Assumption discovery (capability B): search for an enabling φ when the property does not hold → `holds_under` (conditional-only). Mirrors the CLI `--discover-assumptions`.

lift.description: The SV design and how to lift it (the CLI's shared lift flags).

partitions.description: Config-partition config inputs, each `"NAME=v1,v2,..."` (mirrors the CLI `--partition`).

predicates.description: Extra abstraction predicate(s) for the cube-path escalation, each `"NAME:REGISTER=VALUE"` (P2 Slice 1). Used only when the exact engine abstains.

refine.description: Also compute a structured `refinement` alongside the verdict (mirrors the CLI `--refine`). Diagnostic-only — never changes the canonical verdict.

target.description: The `good` atom to recover to (`"REG op VALUE"`).

title: SvVerifyRecoverabilityRequest
